changelog:
- Initial release of video-news-downloader.
- Automates daily downloads of CBS Evening News and BBC News at Ten from YouTube.
- Extracts and proofreads subtitles using DeepSeek AI.
- Serves videos and subtitles over HTTP with embedded web players.
- Supports cron jobs for scheduled updates.
- Provides CLI scripts for video download, subtitle proofreading, and server management.
